description: This Java source file implements the RandomData interface, providing methods for generating various types of random data, including normal, uniform, Poisson, gamma, and other distributions, using underlying random generators. It supports reseeding and configuration of the secure random algorithm. The class delegates core functionality to an instance of RandomDataGenerator.

classes.name: RandomDataImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the RandomData interface providing methods to generate various random types and distributions, delegating to a RandomDataGenerator instance. Supports reseeding and configuration of secure algorithms.

methods.name: nextHexString
methods.description: Generates a hex string of specified length using underlying random generator.

methods.name: nextInt
methods.description: Generates a random integer within specified bounds.

methods.name: nextLong
methods.description: Generates a random long within specified bounds.

methods.name: nextSecureHexString
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure hex string of specified length.

methods.name: nextSecureInt
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure integer within bounds.

methods.name: nextSecureLong
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure long within bounds.

methods.name: nextPoisson
methods.description: Generates a Poisson-distributed random number with given mean.

methods.name: nextGaussian
methods.description: Generates a Gaussian (normal) distributed random number with given mean and std deviation.

methods.name: nextExponential
methods.description: Generates an exponential distribution random number with given mean.

methods.name: nextUniform
methods.description: Generates a uniform random number between lower and upper bounds.

methods.name: nextUniform
methods.description: Generates a uniform random number between bounds with inclusive/exclusive options.

methods.name: nextBeta
methods.description: Samples from a Beta distribution with specified shape parameters.

methods.name: nextBinomial
methods.description: Samples from a Binomial distribution with trials and success probability.

methods.name: nextCauchy
methods.description: Samples from a Cauchy distribution with given median and scale.

methods.name: nextChiSquare
methods.description: Samples from a Chi-Square distribution with specified degrees of freedom.

methods.name: nextF
methods.description: Samples from an F distribution with numerator and denominator degrees of freedom.

methods.name: nextGamma
methods.description: Samples from a Gamma distribution with shape and scale.

methods.name: nextHypergeometric
methods.description: Samples from a Hypergeometric distribution.

methods.name: nextPascal
methods.description: Samples from a Pascal (Negative Binomial) distribution.

methods.name: nextT
methods.description: Samples from a Student's T distribution.

methods.name: nextWeibull
methods.description: Samples from a Weibull distribution.

methods.name: nextZipf
methods.description: Samples from a Zipf distribution.

methods.name: reSeed
methods.description: Reseeds the non-secure random generator with a specified seed.

methods.name: reSeedSecure
methods.description: Reseeds the secure random generator with current time.

methods.name: reSeedSecure
methods.description: Reseeds the secure generator with a specific seed.

methods.name: reSeed
methods.description: Reseeds the generator with current timestamp and hash code.

methods.name: setSecureAlgorithm
methods.description: Sets the algorithm and provider for the SecureRandom instance.

methods.name: nextPermutation
methods.description: Generates a random permutation of n elements choosing k.

methods.name: nextSample
methods.description: Samples k elements from a collection randomly.

methods.name: nextInversionDeviate
methods.description: Generates a deviate from a distribution using inverse transform sampling.

methods.name: nextInversionDeviate
methods.description: Generates a deviate from an integer distribution using inverse transform sampling.
